symptom: create or replace page with `Caption: ''` on a Data grid 2 column whose stored caption is 'Triage' reported 'Unchanged page' and kept 'Triage', on both the keyword `datagrid` and the generic pluggablewidget path.
cause: canon.CarryTranslations adds back every language a rebuilt text did not write, and the empty header was written as a Texts$Text with no translation at all, so the stored en_US 'Triage' was carried straight back. Neither the pluggable passthrough nor the per-property patch was involved.
insight: Bisect by switching mechanisms off, not by reading them: disabling the passthrough, then the patch, changed nothing, and disabling CarryTranslations cleared the caption in one run. 'Unchanged' means canon.Equal saw the stored value in the rebuilt document, so the value is re-added after the build. A text with no translation is indistinguishable, to the carry, from one MDL cannot express; a stated empty text has to be written as (authoring language, ""), and the carry must drop such an item where the stored text has none in that language or every Studio Pro empty caption churns.
